prompt_md: You want to weigh any whole number of kilograms from 1 to 40 on a balance scale, and weights may go on either pan. What's the fewest weights you need?
prompt_short: Weigh any whole kg from 1 to 40, weights on either pan. Fewest weights?
hint_md: A weight can help, get in the way, or sit out.
explain_intuition_md: Weights of 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 and 32 work if they all go on one pan, which is the binary answer of 6. But a weight placed next to the object subtracts, so every weight has three states instead of two. Weights of 1, 3, 9 and 27 cover everything from 1 to 40.
